The 3 Michelin-starred restaurant, Lasarte, offers a range of options designed by the chef Martin Berasategui; while the on-site bistro-style restaurant, Oria, serves fresh cuisine following the Mediterranean gastronomy.

Monument Hotel is a 10-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas; regular trains to Barcelona El Prat Airport leave from Paseo de Gracia Train Station, located 300 metres away. Free high-speed WiFi is provided.

The hotel is housed on Enric Batllo’s house, an architectural jewel of 19th century that constitutes one of the characteristic works of the Eixample Quadrat d'Or and which gives it the Specialty Monument status.

hotel_name: DO Plaça Reial powered by Sonder
description:
Set on Plaza Reial and just off Las Ramblas, DO Plaça Reial powered by Sonder features a spa, a rooftop pool and stylish rooms. Bars and cafés can be found in the square and in the surrounding Gothic Quarter.

Each spacious, air-conditioned room offers a free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV and a free minibar.

In the mornings, the DO Plaça Reial offers a paid breakfast. Creative Mediterranean cuisine and tapas dishes are also served in the restaurant.

The hotel spa features a sauna.

The famous Boquería Market is just 5-minute walk away. Barcelona Cathedral, Liceu Metro and Plaza Catalunya are within 1 km of the hotel.

The apartments are soundproofed, air-conditioned and have free WiFi and a flat-screen TV. All apartments feature a kitchenette fitted with a dishwasher and microwave, as well as a living-dining area.

Bed linen and towels are provided, but only basic, initial cleaning supplies and toiletries are available.

Gaudi's Casa Batllo and La Pedrera are 20 minutes' walk from Hotel Sagrada Familia Apartments. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 14 km away.

Cosmo Apartments Marina – Auditori modern, air-conditioned apartments have flat-screen TVs. They feature wooden floors and chic décor throughout.

All accommodation includes a living room and dining area. The open plan kitchens are equipped with a fridge, dishwasher, microwave, a washer-dryer machine, kettle, and a coffee machine. Some apartments have a DVD player and an extra TV in the bedrooms. All come with private bathroom. Bed linen, towels and kitchenware are provided.


Glories Shopping Centre, the Encants flea market, and Razzmatazz concert hall are 500 metres from the apartments. The centre of Barcelona is just 3 Metro stops away. There are regular bus connections nearby, which connect guests to the city’s beaches in 15 minutes.

The apartments are 100 metres from the Auditori and the National Theatre, and 200 metres from Agbar Tower and the Nord Bus Station.

hotel_name: Sir Victor Hotel, part of Sircle Collection
description:
Sir Victor Hotel, part of Sircle Collection in Barcelona offers stylish accommodation on Passeig de Gràcia, 5 minutes’ walk from Gaudí’s La Pedrera. It features a rooftop swimming pool and a terrace offering excellent views of Barcelona.

Each of the Sir Victor Hotel, part of Sircle Collection rooms has chic, contemporary décor. Rooms overlook Passeig de Gràcia, or the hotel’s interior garden. Each has satellite TV, free Wi-Fi and a large bathroom.

The Spa features steam baths, a sauna, and a state-of the art gym.

The lobby restaurant & bar, MR PORTER, offers an innovative selection of dishes to share.

Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas can be reached in 15 minutes, by foot. Diagonal Metro Station is just 70 metres from the hotel.

Offering different apartments in Barcelona’s modern district of Diagonal Mar, Rent Top Apartments is within 10 minutes' walk from the beach. It offers stylish apartments with private terraces with city, garden or beach views.

Rent Top Apartments is less than 5 minutes’ walk from Diagonal Mar Shopping Centre and from the Forum Building. There is a Tourist Bus stop and a taxi rank just in front of the property, which is also accessible by metro.

Each spacious and bright air-conditioned apartment features modern décor in light colours, and has free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour security service. All come with a lounge with flat-screen TV and DVD player, a well-equipped kitchen and private bathrooms. Some apartments have access to a shared seasonal swimming pool.

Featuring city and sea views, apartments at Rent Top include bed linen, towels, heating and a washing machine.

Set in the heart of Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, Aparthotel Arai 4* Superior features an outdoor swimming pool, a gym with a sauna, and a rooftop terrace with city views from its two terraces.

The Arai is set in an 18th-century building and features stunning frescos on the façades, which are part of the architectural Heritage, historical and artistic of Barcelona, which gives it the Speciality Monument status.

Rooms feature a stylish, rustic décor with exposed stone walls and large windows. The air-conditioned rooms include free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TV. They have a sofa and a small kitchenette with a fridge, microwave and coffee maker. Private bathrooms include free toiletries and a hairdryer.

Aparthotel Arai features Restaurant Palosanto, a classic tavern offering  tapas and Kokka, the first Peruvian bar in Barcelona.

Las Ramblas Avenue and Liceu Metro Station are just 5 minutes’ walk away. Airport buses leave from Plaza Catalunya, 950 metres away. Barcelona’s Port Vell is 10 minutes’ walk from Aparthotel Arai 4* Superior.

Situated in Barcelona, 1.5 km from Palau Sant Jordi, Leonardo Royal Hotel Barcelona Fira features air-conditioned accommodation and a bar. Boasting a 24-hour front desk, this property also welcomes guests with a restaurant and an outdoor pool. Camp Nou is 2.9 km away and Boqueria Market is 4 km from the hotel.

At Leonardo Royal Hotel Barcelona Fira rooms come with a desk, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom.

Guests at the accommodation can enjoy a buffet breakfast.

Leonardo Royal Hotel Barcelona Fira offers a terrace.

Magic Fountain of Montjuic is 2 km from the hotel, while Montjuïc is 2.1 km from the property. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 8 km from Leonardo Royal Hotel Barcelona Fira.

hotel_name: Hotel Barcelona Condal Mar Affiliated by Meliá
description:
The contemporary Hotel Barcelona Condal Mar, managed by Meliá is set in a circular building, 10 minutes’ walk from Mar Bella Beach. It offers a 24-hour gym, and the rooftop pool offers impressive views of Barcelona.

The bright soundproofed rooms at the Hotel Barcelona Condal Mar are spacious and feature air conditioning, satellite TV and free Wi-Fi. Each stylish room has a private bathroom and minibar. There are 2 phone lines.

The Barcelona Condal Mar lobby bar offers a range of cocktails. The bright snack lounge features modern armchairs. Guests can also enjoy a drink in the poolside bar. A buffet breakfast is served in the restaurant.

A special late check-out service, locker and transfer is available during the summer months for an extra cost.

The Barcelona Condal Mar is an 8-minute walk from Maresme Forum Metro Station and  a 2-minute walk from the nearest bus stop. The centre of Barcelona can be reached in around 15 minutes by Metro, Bus or Tram.

hotel_name: Kimpton Vividora Hotel, an IHG Hotel
description:
The Kimpton Vividora Hotel, an IHG Hotel is located in the Gothic Quarter of Barcelona, ​​a short walk from the Plaça Catalunya metro station and in the Portal del Angel shopping district and 10 minutes from the Paseo de Gracia shopping area. This elegantly designed property features a Mediterranean restaurant, a cafeteria, a terrace with a bar and a rooftop pool.

All rooms feature contemporary décor. All have a yoga mat, tea and coffee making facilities, smart TV, minibar and exclusive bathrobe.In addition, the hotel offers the Forgot it? We got it! Which makes available to its guests a whole series of amenities and accessories that will further improve their stay.

The gastronomic space of the Kimpton Vividora Hotel, an IHG chain hotel, has a rooftop terrace with magnificent views of the city, pool, sun loungers, cocktails and snacks, Terraza de Vivi. The Fauna restaurant located on the first floor offers Mediterranean cuisine with Catalan roots in a room reminiscent of a typical Eixample apartment. Got Coffee & Cocktails overlooks the street and serves locally sourced coffee, wine and signature cocktails. This gastronomic space is a place where guests feel at home. Every day from 6pm the free Social Wine Hour is offered to all guests with an open bar of local wines.

This pet-friendly hotel is close to attractions such as Barcelona Cathedral, Plaza de Catalunya and the Palau de la Música Catalana. Barcelona-El Prat Airport, located 15 km away, is the closest.

Our clients say that this part of Barcelona is their favorite, according to independent comments.

45 Times Barcelona Hotel has an outdoor swimming pool, fitness centre, a terrace and restaurant in Barcelona. With free WiFi, this 4-star hotel offers room service and a 24-hour front desk. The property is 2.7 km from Sant Miquel Beach, and within 200 metres of the city centre.

The hotel will provide guests with air-conditioned rooms with a desk, a coffee machine, a minibar, a safety deposit box, a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. All guest rooms feature a wardrobe.

A buffet, continental or American breakfast is available every morning at the property.

Popular points of interest near 45 Times Barcelona Hotel include Plaça Catalunya, Portal de l'Angel and Passeig de Gracia. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km from the property.

Overlooking Barceloneta Beach and Barcelona city centre, this design hotel has 2 outdoor pools and luxury spa with city views. Hotel Arts offers art collection and a restaurant with 2 Michelin stars.

The Arts is situated next to Barcelona’s Olympic Port and surrounded by shops and lively bars. Barceloneta Beach is 250 metres away, while Ciutadella Park is 300 metres away.

Situated in central Barcelona, a 2-minute walk from Girona Metro Station, Tendency Apartments 6 offers accommodation with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and heating. Sagrada Familia Cathedral is a 17-minute walk away.

All apartments have a living area with a flat-screen TV, DVD player, and dining table. The private kitchen is equipped with a hob, microwave, and fridge. Kitchenware is provided in all apartments and some of them have a washing machine and dishwasher.

The apartments include modern furnishings and many of them have a small balcony with views of the city. Each apartment has a private bathroom with a bathtub or a shower, and towels and bed linen are provided. A cot is available upon request.

There are bars and restaurant within a 10-minute walk of the apartments, and a 24-hour grocery shop is just around the corner. Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard, famous for its high-end boutiques and Gaudì’s buildings, can be reached in 7 minutes on foot.

Boasting air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony, Gracia Apartment is set in Barcelona. It is situated less than 1 km from Passeig de Gracia and offers a lift. Offering free WiFi throughout the property, the allergy-free apartment has a sauna.

The spacious apartment has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, bed linen, towels, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a terrace with city views. For added privacy, the accommodation has a private entrance and soundproofing.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include La Pedrera, Casa Batllo and Passeig de Gracia Metro Station. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 13 km from Gracia Apartment.

Barcelonaforrent Tucson Suites is within walking distance of Gaudi’s masterpiece Sagrada Familia. It offers free WiFi; and some apartments have access to a rooftop private terrace.

The modern kitchen at the Tucson Suites, equipped with a dishwasher, ceramic hobs and kitchenware; opens onto a living-dining room featuring brick walls and traditional Catalan vaulted ceilings. There is a washing machine, a dryer and cleaning products are provided.

Numerous bars, restaurants as well as supermarkets can be found within 2 minutes’ walk.

Well connected by public transport, you can reach Barcelona City Centre and fashionable Passeig de Gracia within 15 minutes by metro.

Conveniently located less than 10 minutes’ walk from Hospital Clinic Metro Station, Hotel Viladomat is located in Barcelona. This property features free WiFi and an on-site bar.

Each room at this property is air conditioned and has satellite TV, safe, desk, and minibar. The private bathroom includes a bath, shower, hairdryer, and free toiletries.

Hotel Viladomat has a 24-hour front desk and offers a ticket service. A shuttle to the airport is available for an extra charge, and there is luggage storage on site.

Plaza Catalunya and Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas are 20 minutes away by foot. The friendly staff are happy to provide information on the city and its main points of interest. Sants Station is 1 km away from Hotel Viladomat, with direct links to Barcelona Airport.

Exe Mitre enjoys a peaceful location in the San Gervasi district of Barcelona, 200 metres from Putxet Park. It offers spacious rooms with and free WiFi.

An extensive buffet breakfast is served, with hot and cold options. The friendly staff are happy to recommend restaurants and bars nearby.

The elegant rooms at Exe Mitre feature classic décor and come with a flat-screen TV. Some rooms also have a terrace with views over Mount Tibidabo.

Exe Mitre is just 15 minutes’ walk from Gaudi’s famous Park Guell. Putxet Metro Station is 200 metres away and connects with Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard in just 6 minutes. Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas are an 8-minute metro ride away.

Mesón Castilla is set just 100 metres from Las Ramblas and Plaça Catalunya Square in central Barcelona. The hotel offers free Wi-Fi and an attractive garden terrace where guests can enjoy breakfast.

Rooms at the Mesón Castilla include ornate beds, and some have a private balcony. They come with air conditioning and a private bathroom with a hairdryer.

The hotel operates a 24-hour reception, allowing guests flexibility during their stay. The tour desk can organise excursions and car rental. There are safes available at the reception for an extra charge.

Barcelona’s Modern Art Museum is a 5-minute walk from the hotel. The historic Gothic Quarter, with its cathedral and many bars, can be reached in 10 minutes’ by foot.

Apart-Suites Hostemplo offers stylish apartments and suites set in 2 beautiful Modernist buildings, 250 metres from Gaudí’s Sagrada Familia. This soundproofed accommodation features free Wi-Fi and a DVD player.

The property offers contemporary décor with wooden floors. The apartments come with air conditioning and heating, as well as a private balcony. Most have views of Sagrada Família. Most of the apartments have a washing machine.

A buffet breakfast with homemade pastries, local produce and freshly squeezed natural orange juice is served daily at Hotel Hostemplo, located 150 meters from the property.

The junior suite features a fridge, microwave and kettle, and it has a TV. Located on the 5th floor, it offers views of Sagrada Família.

In 5 minutes you can walk to Sagrada Família Market, as well as Gaudí Avenue, where there are many restaurants, bars and shops. Barcelona's open-top bus tour route also stops just 3 minutes' walk from the property.

Apart-Suites Hostemplo is situated just metres from Avinguda Diagonal and just 3 minutes' walk from Sagrada Família Metro Station. Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are a 10-minute walk away on Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard, in the city centre.

hotel_name: Leonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia
description:
Leonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia is located just 15 minutes’ walk from Gaudí’s famous Sagrada Familia. It has a rooftop sun terrace with panoramic views of Barcelona and rooms with free Wi-Fi.

All modern, outward-facing rooms at theLeonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia are equipped with air conditioning and heating. They have a flat-screen TV and the private bathrooms come with a hairdryer.

Leonardo Boutique Hotel Barcelona Sagrada Familia serves a daily buffet breakfast, and gluten-free meals are available on prior request. In summer, breakfast can be enjoyed on the terrace. There are also vending machines with snacks and drinks.

Staff at the hotel’s 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona. Clot Metro Station is 200 metres away, allowing you to reach the city centre in 10 minutes.

Hotel Ramblas Internacional is set right on the famous Las Ramblas, 50 metres from Liceu Metro Station and close to La Boquería Market.
Each of the soundproofed rooms is individually decorated and has plenty of natural light. Most rooms offer views of central Barcelona and some look onto Las Ramblas.

Hotel Ramblas Internacional serves a daily breakfast.

Located just 150 metres from Liceu Theatre, the hotel has easy access to Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter and the city’s cathedral is less than 10 minutes’ walk away.

Feelathome Center Apartments offers a selection of quality apartments located in different areas of central Barcelona. Please check the room information to see the exact address of each apartment as well as pictures and descriptions

All  partments are located within 20 minutes’ walk of Plaza Catalunya, Barcelona’s main square. Most are in the stylish Eixample district.

Each apartment has a TV in the living room, and many also have a sofa bed. They have modern kitchens and bathrooms and most have parquet floors.

Every apartment is located close to a Metro Station which gives you access to the main tourist sights in under 15 minutes.

Located in the lively Raval district and 250 metres from Las Ramblas, Hotel Casa Teva Barcelona has easy access to Barcelona’s Old Town. It features 24-hour reception and air-conditioned rooms with a TV.

Gaudi‘s Palau Güell is only 100 metres from the hotel, whilst La Boqueria Market is just a 5-minute walk away.

There are several restaurants, bars and cafés in the surrounding area. Barcelona’s Old Port and Maremagnum Shopping Centre are a 20-minute walk from the hotel.

Drassanes Metro Station is approximately 500 metres from the hotel.  Guests can reach sights such as the Sagrada Familia and Parc Güell in around 20 minutes, by Metro.

Located in the quiet San Gervasi district of Barcelona, this elegant hotel offers modern rooms with free internet connection. The Silken is just 8 minutes by train from Plaza Catalunya.

The restaurant at Silken San Gervasi offers traditional cuisine with modern influences. A breakfast buffet is served in the cafeteria, and drinks and snacks are also available throughout the day.

Functional rooms include a free safe and central heating and air conditioning. The marble bathroom is complete with a hairdryer.

Silken St. Gervasi is a 15-minute walk from Park Guell, with impressive structures, mosaics and architecture by Antoni Gaudí. El Putxet Station can be found 50 metres from the hotel with direct access to the city centre.

Set in the centre of Barcelona, Mihlton Barcelona Boutique B&B is a recently renovated accommodation, which offers allergy-free rooms. Boasting a lift, this property also provides guests with a sun terrace. The accommodation features luggage storage space, a housekeeping service and organising tours for guests.

All units feature air conditioning and a satellite flat-screen TV. Units are equipped with a private bathroom, a safety deposit box and free WiFi, while certain rooms also offer a balcony and some have garden views. At the bed and breakfast, every unit comes with bed linen and towels.

Buffet and continental breakfast options with warm dishes, local specialities and champagne are available every morning. There is a coffee shop, and a minimarket is also available.

Guests at the bed and breakfast will be able to enjoy activities in and around Barcelona, like walking tours. The bed and breakfast has a picnic area where you can spend a day out in the open.

Popular points of interest near Mihlton Barcelona Boutique B&B include Passeig de Gracia, La Pedrera and Casa Batllo. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km from the property.

Offering free WiFi throughout the property, Hotel Boutique Hostemplo is located on a pedestrian street just 100 metres from Barcelona's Sagrada Familia. The hotel has a friendly and very peaceful atmosphere.

Each room comes with a flat-screen TV. Some rooms have a seating area to relax in after a busy day. You will find a kettle in the room. Every room comes with a private bathroom equipped with a shower. For your comfort, you will find a hairdryer and toiletries.

The surroundings are full of bars, restaurants and shops, like the F.C. Barcelona Museum. Las Glorias Shopping Centre is a 10-minute walk away. Gaudí’s Pedrera and Casa Batlló are 10 minutes' walk away. Sagrada Familia Metro Station, located 2 minutes' walk away, connects you with the city centre in 7 minutes, offering easy access to Plaza Catalunya, the Ramblas and the beach.

You can buy discounted tickets for the tourist bus, which stops 100 metres from the hotel.

The buffet breakfast with homemade pastries, local products and freshly squeezed natural orange juice is served daily in our café from 08:00 to 10:30.

Cuatro Naciones has an ideal location on Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas, 200 metres from Drassanes Metro Station. Set in an 18th-century building, it features rooms with free Wi-fi and a flat-screen satellite TV.

The Naciones features simple décor throughout. Its air-conditioned rooms have private bathrooms with a hairdryer.

Barcelona Cathedral is approximately 10 minutes’ walk away.  The city’s old port is just 400 metres from the hotel.

There is a selection of restaurants, bars and cafés in the Gothic Quarter, which is 5 minutes’ walk from the Cuatro Naciones.

Set in the traditional, fishing district of Barceloneta, next to the central city beach. This hotel provides value and practical accommodation, ideal for those travelling on a budget.

After a hearty breakfast, head out along the impressive Barcelona beachfront. Stop for a morning coffee or a bite to eat, next to the waterfront. Here you can spend the day strolling around this charming neighbourhood, or you can walk into the Gothic Quarter, or the popular Born neighbourhood – 5 minutes’ walk away.

This hotel has a small social lounge, where you can sit and read, or chat with friends or fellow guests.

Situated on Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas, Hostal Benidorm offers free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception and air-conditioned rooms with satellite TV. Liceu Metro Station is just 200 metres away.

Each room at the Benidorm Hostal features simple décor and tiled floors. All rooms have central heating and a private bathroom.

Drinks and snacks are available from vending machines in the Benidorm’s reception area. Staff at the front desk can provide information about the city and arrange car or bicycle rental.

Hostal Benidorm is located just outside the historic Gothic Quarter. Gaudi’s Palau Güell is 100 metres away, while the Boqueria Market is within 400 metres. Barceloneta Beach can be reached in 25 minutes’ walk or a 10-minute bus.

Offering a 1960’s vibe and rooms with vintage décor, this hotel is set in the heart of Barcelona, only 2 minutes’ walk from the famous Ramblas.  Free Wi-Fi is available throughout.

Each air-conditioned room at Sixties Ramblas features a TV and a private bathroom. Most rooms have a balcony.

Sixties Ramblas has a bar and a restaurant. Staff at the 24-hour reception can provide tourist information about the area. Bike rental services are also available, and there is also a stylish white billiards table.

The nearest Metro Station is Drassanes, only 2 minutes’ walk from the hotel. You can also walk to the harbour or Plaza Catalunya Square in less than 10 minutes.

Sixties Ramblas is close to the Born district, with numerous trendy bars and restaurants serving local and international food.

Hotel Call Barcelona is located right in the centre of Barcelona’s historic Barri Gótic, 10 minutes' walk from Las Ramblas. It is close to Plaça Sant Jaume and not far from the Cathedral.

The rooms in the Hotel Call are spacious and practical. It offers air conditioned or heated accommodation, depending on the season. There is free Wi-Fi and a safe. The bathrooms have a shower.

The nearest Metro stops are Jaume I and Liceu, both about 10 minutes’ away. The famous Ramblas are also about 10 minutes’ walk away.

Hotel Call is also close to central Barcelona’s main shopping areas such as Portaferrisa and Portal de L'Àngel. The trendy Born area is also close by – here you will find plenty of restaurants and bars.

Situated in Barcelona, 1.3 km from Sants Railway Station and 1.8 km from Magic Fountain of Montjuic, ArtlifeBCN Urban Oasis Apartment features air-conditioned accommodation with a patio and free WiFi. Ideally situated in the Sants-Montjuïc district, this apartment provides a garden. The property is non-smoking and is located 3.2 km from Camp Nou.

The spacious apartment has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, bed linen, towels, a flat-screen TV with streaming services, a dining area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a terrace with garden views. The property has an outdoor dining area.

Palau Sant Jordi is 3.5 km from the apartment, while Casa Batllo is 4.4 km from the property. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 9 km away.

This family-run hotel is within 200 metres of Las Ramblas and Plaza Catalunya. All rooms are made of natural, organic materials and painted with PVC-free paint.
All rooms at Hostal Grau have a private bathroom with free toiletries made from natural sources such as lavender. Some rooms have a balcony; while others face a vertical garden.
The whole building features energy efficient lighting and a water recycling system, as well as using renewable or clean energy.
Free natural teas and infusions, are available from the on-site lounge.
The MACBA Modern Art Museum is just 350 metres from the guest house, and Port Vell Harbour is a 15-minute walk away. Direct buses to Barcelona Airport stop in nearby Plaza Universitat.

Overlooking Camp Nou Stadium and Diagonal Avenue, the modern NH Barcelona Stadium offers free WiFi, a gym and seasonal rooftop pool. The air-conditioned rooms have flat-screen satellite TV, minibar and a pillow menu.

NH Barcelona Stadium Hotel’s seasonal sun terrace offers wonderful views across Barcelona to Montjuic. It also has sun loungers.

The hotel’s restaurant, Acanto, offers a varied buffet breakfast, as well as an á la carte lunch menu. The lobby café is open until midnight every day. The restaurant is closed during summer months.

Les Corts Metro Station is just 5 minutes’ walk away and offers a direct link to Barcelona’s historic centre. Diagonal Avenue can be reached in 10 minutes on foot, and Sants Station is 1.5 km away.

Barcelona's Fira Congress Centre is a 10-minute drive from the hotel. Barcelona El Prat Airport can also be reached in 10 minutes by car.

Feelathome Plaza Apartments offers apartments with free Wi-Fi and heating. The apartments are 100 metres from Hostafrancs Metro Station and 650 metres from Plaza Espanya and Barcelona Fira Congress Centre.

Featuring stylish décor, all the apartments include a seating area, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a DVD player. Most of the apartments have a balcony or terrace. Every apartment has access to a communal rooftop terrace with views of the area.

Each apartment has a dining area and a kitchen equipped with a washing machine, oven and coffee machine. The bathrooms come with a shower and bed linen and towels are provided.

Guests will find restaurants and shops within 3 minutes' walk from the property. The apartments are 3 km from Plaza Catalunya Square and Barcelona city centre. Sants Train Station is a 10-minute walk from the property.

These modern apartments are in the Poblenou area of Barcelona, 500 metres from the beach. Free Wi-Fi is available in rooms and in public areas. The CCIB Convention Centre is within walking distance.

Poblenou Metro is 200 metres away and a 20-minute ride takes you to the city centre. There is easy access to the Gaudí buildings on Passeig de Gracia.

The apartments located in 2 separate buildings, 210 metres apart. All of them have a private kitchen complete with a washing machine, dishwasher, and oven. There is also a living room with a flat-screen TV.  Some apartments have a private terrace or balcony, and a communal terrace is available on the top floor.

Private parking is available at an extra cost. Non-smoking and family apartments are available.

The pictures at the top of this page are a selection of the different apartments located in the Poble Nou area in Barcelona. Please select a date and click on the apartments to see the pictures of the individual apartments.

The Caledonian has an ideal setting on Barcelona's Gran Vía, just 5 minutes' walk from Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas. Its rooms include free Wi-Fi internet access.

The air-conditioned rooms at the Caledonian feature simple, attractive décor with wooden floors. Each has a minibar and some rooms offer views of Gran Vía.

The hotel serves a daily buffet breakfast in its dining room. There is a good selection of restaurants within 10 minutes’ walk of the Caledonian.

Universitat Metro Station is just 100 metres from the hotel and connects guests to sights such as Gaudí’s La Perdrera and the Sagrada Familia within 15 minutes.

Guests can make use of services such as the 24-hour front desk and express check-in and check-out. The hotel also has luggage storage.

Aparthotel Bertrán is located in a quiet part of Barcelona, 5 minutes’ walk from Avinguda Tibidabo FGC Station and Vallcarca Metro. It offers spacious accommodation, a gym and an outdoor pool.

Each air-conditioned Bertrán apartment has a living room with satellite TV and a sofa. The private bathroom comes with a hairdryer, and there is a kitchenette with a fridge, microwave and coffee maker.

Some apartments have a private balcony with table and chairs. All apartments have free Wi-Fi.

A continental breakfast is available at the Bertrán, and you can have breakfast in your apartment. There is a supermarket 2 minutes’ walk away.

There is a 24-hour reception, and you can hire a car from the tour desk. On-site parking is available for an extra charge.

You can reach Barcelona city centre in 15 minutes by train, Metro or bus, and there is a night bus stop nearby. Parc Güell is just over 1 km away.

Barcelona Princess Hotel is a 10-minute walk from the beach in the city’s Forum area. It offers wonderful views and a free gym. Free WiFi is available throughout.

All guests have free access to the 2 heated outdoor pools. The one on the 23rd floor offers spectacular sea views.

Rooms at Princess Barcelona are elegant and bright. Each has contemporary décor. All rooms have satellite TV.

The hotel has a Mediterranean restaurant and 2 stylish bars, including a relaxed poolside bar with panoramic views.

Princess Hotel Barcelona is set on Avenida Diagonal, next to Diagonal Mar Shopping Centre. The tour bus stops in front of the hotel and Maresme Forum Metro Station is 100 metres away. Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas can be reached in 15 minutes, by Metro.

Astoria is just off Barcelona’s Diagonal Avenue, a 5-minute walk from Diagonal Metro Station and Paseo de Gracia Avenue. It features a rooftop pool with views, and a gym.

The Astoria Hotel combines original Art Nouveau features with modern facilities. Air-conditioned rooms have satellite TV, a safe and minibar. They feature wooden floors and free Wi-Fi, and the modern bathrooms come with a hairdryer.

The restaurant at the Astoria offers traditional Catalan cuisine, and room service is available. There is also a terrace and a bar.

There is a 24-hour front desk

Blanc Guest House is 8 minutes’ walk from Barcelona’s famous Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard. It offers an attractive terrace and smart rooms with free Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV.

The rooms at Blanc Guest House are decorated in white, with parquet floors and white furniture. Each one comes with air conditioning, heating and a fan, and some have a private bathroom.

Staff at reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona. Car rental is also available from the front desk.

The Blanc is 8 minutes’ walk from Diagonal Metro Station, connecting you with the rest of the city with ease. Plaza Catalunya is just 2 stops away.

hotel_name: Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
description:
Set in Barcelona, 1.9 km from Nova Mar Bella Beach, Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel offers accommodation with an outdoor swimming pool, private parking, a fitness centre and a terrace. This 4-star hotel offers a business centre, a concierge service and free WiFi. Guests can make use of a bar.

At the hotel every room includes air conditioning, a seating area, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel provides certain units with city views, and all rooms come with a coffee machine. The units will provide guests with a desk and a kettle.

A buffet, à la carte or continental breakfast is available at the property. At the accommodation you will find a restaurant serving Middle Eastern and international cuisine. Vegetarian, dairy-free and vegan options can also be requested.

Speaking German, English, Spanish and French, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical information on the area at the reception.

Llevant is 2.1 km from Labtwentytwo Barcelona, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, while Mar Bella Beach is 2.1 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 17 km from the property.

Wilson Boutique Hotel is situated on Barcelona’s Avinguda Diagonal, 12 minutes’ walk from La Pedrera in Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard. It offers free Wi-Fi, stylish décor and a rooftop terrace with impressive city views.

The Wilson Boutique Hotel has soundproofed rooms with chic, contemporary design. All rooms are bright with large windows. Each has a flat-screen TV and air conditioning.

The hotel is within walking distance of Plaza de Catalunya which features a range of shops and restaurants.

The Wilson Boutique has excellent transport links. Many buses, including the sightseeing bus, stop opposite the hotel.

The hotel offers free use of the PC and printer in the lobby. There is also a tour desk, where guests can receive information on Barcelona’s tourist attractions, including Gaudí’s Casa Batlló which is around 20 minutes’ walk from the Wilson. Diagonal Metro Station is 750 metres away.

Room Mate Pau is set 50 metres from the emblematic Plaza Catalunya. It offers a stylish décor and a terrace and bright, contemporary rooms with free Wi-Fi.

Rooms at Room Mate Pau feature chic decor and air conditioning. All include a plasma TV with USB port for laptop connection, a minibar, safe and a modern private bathroom.

A buffet breakfast is served daily, which you can enjoy at the property's shared terrace. Events can be catered for and various bars, restaurants and shops are within 2 minutes’ walk.

Other facilities include meeting and conference rooms.

Room Mate Pau is 2 minutes’ walk from Las Ramblas and Passeig de Gracia, with its exclusive shops and Gaudí monuments. Urquinaona Metro station is 150 metres away, 2 stops from Barceloneta and its beach.

The hotel can help book tickets and activities and is 250 metres from Catalunya Metro and FGC Train Station.

Hotel Inglés is located right next to the Ramblas and Boquería market, 5 minutes’ walk from Plaça Catalunya. It offers 24-hour reception and rooms with free Wi-Fi and satellite TV.

Air-conditioned rooms at the Inglés are simple and comfortable. They come with a private bathroom and some rooms have a private balcony.

A breakfast is served every morning in a restaurant located next to the hotel.

Staff at the hotel’s 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona. You can also hire a car and store your luggage at the front desk.

The Palau de la Música Catalana, a Modernist auditorium, is 10 minutes’ walk from the Hotel Inglés. The characterful streets of the Gothic Quarter are on the doorstep, and you can walk to the trendy Born area in around 5 minutes.

Hostel Friends Barcelona is located on the well-known Gran Vía Avenue in Barcelona, 500 metres from Plaza Espanya Square. Free WiFi access is available and 24-hour reception is featured.

This guest house offers free services like luggage storage and safe box.

Rooms at Friends Barcelona have heating, a fan and a small fridge, as well as a hairdryer. Some rooms have a private bathroom, a balcony and a flat-screen TV, while others have a shared bathroom and a TV. Bed linen and towels are included.

The area has very good public transport links. Rocafort metro station is only a minute on foot. Sagrada Familia Temple is 20 minutes by metro.

Exe Ramblas Boquería is situated right on Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas, next to La Boquería Market. The stylish, air-conditioned rooms offer free WiFi, flat-screen satellite TV and a private balcony.

Exe Ramblas Boquería features elegant modern décor, with hardwood floors and designer furniture. The soundproofed rooms have views of Las Ramblas or the colourful Boqueria Market.

A varied buffet breakfast is served in the Exe Ramblas Boquería’s bright dining room. The Boquería is an ideal place to sample typical tapas and fresh fruit, while numerous restaurants and bars can be found nearby.

Barcelona Cathedral and Plaça Catalunya are both within 400 metres of the hotel. Liceu Metro Station is just 100 metres away.

Hotel Del Comte is 100 metres from Barcelona's Urgell Metro Station and 15 minutes walk from the Rambla and Plaza Espanya. It offers modern rooms with free Wi-Fi and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels.

The air-conditioned rooms at Del Comte feature parquet floors and smart design. Each one comes with a work desk and a private bathroom with a hairdryer.

Staff at the Del Comte Hotel’s 24-hour reception can provide information about what to see and do in Barcelona.

There is a bus stop just 3 minutes’ walk from the Del Comte which provides transport connections to Barcelona El Prat Airport. It is only 2 stops on the Metro to Plaza Catalunya, Barcelona’s main square.

Situated 200 metres from Las Ramblas in central Barcelona, Catalonia Avinyo features a rooftop pool and gym. It offers chic, air-conditioned rooms with satellite TV and free Wi-Fi.

Rooms are decorated in a modern, minimalist style with large wall photos. They include a minibar, safe and telephone. All hotel rooms have smart TVs, which are equipped with Chromecast app. The modern bathrooms have a shower and a hairdryer.

Barceloneta Beach is a 15-minute walk from Hotel Catalonia Avinyo. The Liceu and Jaume I Metro Stations are just 300 metres away and Barcelona Cathedral is 4 minutes' walk away.

The Avinyo’s central location means there are many shops, bars and restaurants close to the hotel. Bicycle and car hire can be arranged at the tour desk.

Offering beautiful, stylish rooms Hotel Ciutadella Barcelona has an ideal central setting within 300 metres of Santa María del Mar Church, Ciutadella Park and Barceloneta Metro Station. It offers easy access to the historic Born and Gothic districts.

Each air-conditioned room at Hotel Ciutadella Barcelona has contemporary décor. All rooms have a TV and a private bathroom.

Bars and cafés can be found along Passeig del Born, 200 metres away. There are several seafood restaurants along the seaside Passeig de Joan de Borbó, a 5-minute walk from the Hotel Ciutadella.

The nearest beaches can be reached in 15 minutes by foot. Plaza de Catalunya and Las Ramblas are within 2 km of the hotel.

hotel_name: Radisson Blu 1882 Hotel, Barcelona Sagrada Familia
description:
Set in Barcelona, 400 metres from Sagrada Familia, Radisson Blu 1882 Hotel, Barcelona Sagrada Familia has an outdoor pool and a fitness centre. The 4-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with a private bathroom and free WiFi.

At the hotel, each room comes with a desk. The rooms are fitted with a flat-screen TV, and certain rooms include a city view. All rooms feature a wardrobe.

A continental breakfast is served every morning at the property.

Radisson Blu 1882 Hotel, Barcelona Sagrada Familia offers a terrace with views of Sagrada Familia.

Staff are ready to help around the clock.

La Pedrera is a 14-minute walk from the accommodation. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 14 km from Radisson Blu 1882 Hotel, Barcelona Sagrada Familia.

Catalonia Diagonal Centro is set in the heart of Barcelona’s Eixample district, 300 metres from Diagonal Metro Station. It features a seasonal outdoor pool and free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel.

At the Catalonia Diagonal Centro, you can enjoy modern, comfortable accommodation next to some of Barcelona’s most popular sights. All hotel rooms have smart TVs, which are equipped with Chromecast app

Only 300 metres away on Passeig de Gràcia is La Pedrera, one of Gaudi’s famous creations. Take a stroll past the Modernista buildings to reach Plaça Catalunya and the lively Ramblas area.

Back at the hotel, relax in your stylish bedroom with contemporary wooden furniture and marble en suite bathroom. Watch satellite television or take advantage of the free wireless internet connection.

A short stroll from the hotel takes you to trendy Gràcia, with its bohemian shops and leafy squares, and a huge selection of bars and restaurants. Nearby metro and bus lines make it easy to see the whole of this cosmopolitan city.

Barcelona Center is 400 metres from Barcelona’s Passeig de Gràcia Avenue, and a 15-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya. Guests have free access to the small gym and rooftop hydromassage tub.

The modern rooms at the Barcelona Center Hotel have satellite TV and free WiFi. There is a minibar and safe, and the private bathroom comes with a hairdryer and amenities.

The Center Hotel has a traditional Spanish restaurant. There is also a bar and a rooftop bar.

There is a 24-hour front desk. Parking is available nearby (first to arrive first to take) for an additional charge of 30€ per night and car.

Located in Barcelona’s Eixample District, beside Rocafort Metro Station and 15 minutes’ walk from Plaza Catalunya,  Chi Hotel offers rooms with air-conditioning and heating (depending on the season) and free WiFi.

The modern rooms include a flat-screen TV, minibar, safe and a private bathroom with free toiletries and a hairdryer.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. Staff can help with tourist information and car hire.

You will find many shops, restaurants and bars in the surrounding area.

Feelathome Mozart Apartments offers air-conditioned apartments located 5 minutes' walk from Barcelona's Diagonal Metro Station. Free WiFi is available and some apartments have a private terrace.

Each apartment features a seating area with a flat-screen TV and DVD player. There is a well-equipped kitchen, which includes a dishwasher and washing machine, and the private bathroom comes with a shower and hairdryer. Towels and bed linen are provided.

An airport shuttle service is available for an extra charge. Plaza Catalunya and La Rambla are a pleasant 20-minute stroll down the famous Passeig de Gracia Avenue, with its iconic buildings like La Pedrera and Casa Batlló.

Barcelona Universal offers free Wi-Fi, a gym and a rooftop pool with city ciews. Situated next to next to Parallel Metro Station, the hotel is just 600 metres from Las Ramblas.

The spacious, functional rooms at the Barcelona Universal Hotel feature wooden floors and air conditioning. Bathrooms include toiletries and heated towel rails.

The Barcelona Universal’s Medea serves a hot and cold buffet breakfast, including plenty of healthy options.

The hotel is situated a 20-minute walk from the Magic Fountain and MNAC Art Museum, in Montjuïc. Plaça Catalunya is just 3 Metro stops away, and the lively bars of the Raval district are just 500 metres away.

hotel_name: Cosmo Apartments Consell de Cent - Plaza Universitat
description:
Located 700 metres from central Barcelona’s Universitat Square, this property offers stylish, well-equipped apartments. It is 300 metres from Urgell Metro Station, just 2 stops from Las Ramblas and Plaza de Catalunya.

Each air-conditioned apartment has chic, contemporary décor with chrome finishes and trendy furnishings. The living room has a sofa, a flat-screen TV and an iPod docking station.

The kitchen includes an electric hob, an oven, microwave, dishwasher and a kettle. There is also a dining area.

Shops, bars and cafés can be found in the streets surrounding the apartments and on Universitat Square, 10 minutes’ walk away.

The apartments are within 1.5 km of Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter, the Raval District and the CCCB Art Gallery. Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard and the famous Gaudí houses can be reached in just 10 minutes by Metro.

The airport bus stops 150 metres away, while Sants Railway Station and the AVE High-Speed Train are easily accessed by Metro from the nearby Catalunya Station.

Featuring a roof terrace and free Wi-Fi, Flor Parks is set on Barcelona’s Las Ramblas, beside Liceu Metro Station. Located 200 metres from La Boqueria Market, it offers soundproofed rooms.

The Flor Parks' air-conditioned rooms have a balcony, satellite TV and a minibar. Their private bathrooms have hairdryers and some have hydromassage baths.

Set menu and à la carte dishes are served at the Hotel Flor’s restaurant. There is also a snack bar and café.

The hotel’s central location makes it perfect for exploring the city’s Gothic Quarter and Barcelona Cathedral is just 10 minutes’ walk away. The Port and Maremagnum Shopping Centre are less than 1 km from the Flor Parks.

Zenit Barcelona is 250 metres from Plaza Francesc Macià on Barcelona’s Diagonal Avenue. This modern hotel offers stylish air-conditioned and soundproofed rooms, with free Wi-Fi and a pillow menu.

The Zenit is a 15-minute walk from Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard, where Gaudí’s famous La Pedrera and Casa Batlló can be found. Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas are a further 15 minutes’ walk away.

Rooms at the Zenit Barcelona feature satellite TV and a safe and minibar. There is a work desk and a kettle with free tea and coffee set; the private bathrooms come with a hairdryer.

Zenit Hotel’s restaurant offers gourmet Spanish and international cuisine. A special gluten-free breakfast and children's menus are available, and packed lunches and room service can be requested.

There is a 24-hour front desk and a tour desk. A laundry, dry cleaning and ironing service is offered. Parking is available 10 minutes' walk away, for an extra cost.

Set in Barcelona’s vibrant Raval district, this design hotel offers free Wi-Fi, a gym and a roof terrace with pool and panoramic views. Some rooms include a Nespresso coffee machine.

Each bright, air-conditioned room at the Barceló Raval features a large plasma-screen TV with more than 70 channels. Rooms have a minibar and a modern bathroom.

Hotel Barceló Raval’s B-Lounge serves creative Mediterranean food, tapas and cocktails in stylish surroundings. You can also enjoy a drink on the outdoor terrace.

The Raval Barceló is only a 5-minute walk from the MACBA Modern Art Gallery. Liceu Metro Station, Las Ramblas and the famous Boqueria Market are all just 400 metres away.

Located in Barcelona and with Mar Bella Beach reachable within 700 metres, Latroupe Poblenou Beach provides concierge services, non-smoking rooms, a shared lounge, free WiFi throughout the property and a terrace. The property is around 700 metres from Bogatell Beach, less than 1 km from Nova Mar Bella Beach and 2.2 km from Somorrostro Beach. The accommodation features a shared kitchen, a tour desk and luggage storage for guests.

A buffet, continental or vegetarian breakfast is available daily at the property.

Around the clock assistance is available at the reception, where staff speak Catalan, Czech, English and Spanish.

Barceloneta Beach is 2.8 km from the hostel, while Port Olimpic is 2.3 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 15 km from the property.

Set 50 metres from the Ramblas, in the Raval district, Dalia Ramblas features air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi. Well served by public transport, it offers 24-hour reception and free luggage storage.

Featuring a modern and functional décor, rooms come with a flat-screen TV, wardrobe and a desk. All have a private bathroom with bath or shower. Free toiletries and hairdryer are provided.

Dalia Ramblas is set in the lively city centre. There are plenty of bars and restaurants in the surrounding area.

Next to the Gothic Quarter, Dalia Ramblas is 10 minutes’ walk from Plaza Catalunya and from Barcelona Cathedral. You can also reach the bustling Plaza Reial Square in a 5-minute walk.

Barcelona Airport is 12 km away from the hotel. Regular airport buses leave from a bus stop located just 800 metres away.

Located in Barcelona’s Eixample district, this 19th-century building offers stylish modern interiors and free WiFi. It is just 300 metres from the designer shops and Gaudí buildings of Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard.

The Catalonia Eixample 1864 is housed in one of the Eixample’s oldest buildings, and its painted façade gives it the Speciality Monument status.

All soundproofed en-suite rooms sleek wooden floors and furniture, air conditioning and all rooms have smart TVs, which are equipped with Chromecast app.. Some rooms have a private terrace and pool.

A buffet breakfast with show cooking is offered every morning at the Sala Minerva; while the hotel's Les Finestres de Llúria restaurant serves traditional Catalan food with a creative twist. Room service is also available.

Catalonia Eixample 1864 boasts a rooftop swimming pool, sundeck and bar; as well as a gym.

The Catalonia Eixample 1864 is ideally located just a 5-minute walk from Passeig de Gracia Station. Plaza Catalunya Square is a 10-minute walk away.

The hotel offers private parking on-site for an extra cost and an electric vehicle charging station.

Set in Barcelona in the Catalonia Region, 200 metres from Plaza Reial, May Ramblas Hotel boasts a sun terrace and views of the city. Free WiFi is available throughout the property.

Every room at this hotel is air conditioned and features a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. A terrace or balcony are featured in certain rooms. All rooms have a private bathroom with free toiletries and a hairdryer.

There is a 24-hour front desk at the property.

La Seu, Cathedral of Barcelona is 400 metres from May Ramblas Hotel, while Portal de l'Angel is 500 metres away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 12 km from the property.

hotel_name: Blasco de Garay Apartment - Poble Sec
description:
Situated in Barcelona, 1.2 km from Magic Fountain of Montjuic and 1.8 km from Plaça Catalunya, Blasco de Garay Apartment - Poble Sec features air-conditioned accommodation with a balcony and free WiFi. It is located 3.2 km from Tivoli Theatre and offers a lift. The property is non-smoking and is set 1.8 km from Portal de l'Angel.

This apartment has 2 bedrooms, a kitchen with a dishwasher and an oven, a TV, a seating area and 1 bathroom. For added privacy, the accommodation features a private entrance.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include Palau Sant Jordi, Passeig de Gracia and Boqueria Market. The nearest airport is Barcelona El Prat Airport, 12 km from Blasco de Garay Apartment - Poble Sec.

Happy People Ramblas Harbour Apartments is just 5 minutes’ walk from Parallel Metro Station. It offers stylish air-conditioned apartments in the Poble Sec neighbourhood, close to cafés, bars and restaurants.

Each bright, spacious, open-plan apartment at Happy People Ramblas Harbour has high ceilings with exposed wooden beams, tiled floors and stylish décor. The living area has a sofa and a kitchen area with microwave and fridge. Free Wi-Fi is included.

On the last floor of the buiding there is a rooftop with the views to the city and where you can also enjoy  the swimming pool.

You can walk to Las Ramblas and the Gothic Quarter in just 15 minutes.

Barcelona’s port and cruise terminal are within 15 minutes’ walk of the apartments. Buses to Barceloneta’s beaches stop nearby.

This hotel is set in the heart of the cosmopolitan city of Barcelona, just a short distance from Las Ramblas and within walking distance of attractions such as the Liceu opera house and Plaça Catalunya.

The Hotel Alba is located in Barcelona’s old town, and its beautiful façade is listed for its artistic interest. Inside, relax in a spacious en suite bedroom with balcony and air conditioning.

Stroll down the colourful Ramblas to the seafront, or enjoy cava and tapas in the famous Boqueria food market. Just a short walk away, the narrow streets of the Gothic Quarter are full of shops, bars and restaurants.

The Alba boasts convenient public transport links, with Liceu metro station only 300 metres away. From here you can travel quickly and conveniently to attractions including the Fira de Barcelona and Gaudi’s incredible Parc Güell.

Catalonia Roma is 600 metres from Sants AVE Train and Metro Station. It offers free Wi-Fi, and you can reach Barcelona city centre in 10 minutes by Metro or bus.

There are direct train links to Barcelona Airport from Sants Station and the Airport Bus also stops outside it.

The modern, air-conditioned rooms have wooden floors, a mini fridge with complimentary water and satellite TV. There is a safe and minibar, and a private bathroom with a hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast is served at the hotel restaurant. Room service is available and there is also a bar.

Plaza Espanya, Montjuic’s Magic Fountain and the Fira Conference Centre are all within 15 minutes’ walk of the hotel.

The 24-hour front desk at Catalonia Roma boasts a large stained-glass skylight. You can rent a car and currency exchange is offered.

Pets: Only one dog or cat less than 20 kg is allowed per room (on request). Supplement of 22€ night/animal and deposit of 200€.

The Barcelona City North Hostal offers value-for-money accommodation and free Wi-Fi. It is in the quiet Sarrià-Sant Gervasi area of Barcelona, with good access by car to the airport.

The rooms at the Barcelona City North are clean, heated and air conditioned. All come with a private bathroom, a TV and a kettle.

Guests at Barcelona City North Hostal have access to a common area with a microwave and fridge.

The hostel is within walking distance of the popular Gràcia neighbourhood and the Modernist buildings of the Eixample.

Nearby Lesseps Metro Station offers easy access to Vallcarca and the Parc Güell. Plaça Catalunya is only 3 stops away.

Set in a restored building from 1893, AG Apartments is located in the Poble Sec area of Barcelona. Free Wi-Fi access is available. Plaza Espanya Square is 1.2 km away.

The reception area at the AG Apartments features a photography gallery. All apartments are decorated with photographs from the artist Enrique Rottenberg and feature a blend of rustic and industrial styles, preserving the original brick walls, arches and exposed beams, as well as the wooden doors and ceramic floors.

Each apartment has air conditioning and heating. There is a living room with a 42-inch Smart TV, a fully equipped open-plan kitchen and a modern bathroom. Some apartments have a balcony. Bed linen and towels are included. The building has a lift.

The nearest metro station is Poble Sec, 400 metres away. From there, you can reach Plaza Catalunya in 4 metro stops.  El Prat Airport is 20 minutes' drive away and buses leave from Plaza Espanya.

The pictures at the top of this page are a selection of the different apartments located in the Poble Sec area. Please select a date and click on the apartments to see the pictures of the individual apartments.

This modern hotel offers spacious, air-conditioned suites with a separate seating area, private balcony, free WiFi and 2 TVs. The hotel is 10 minutes’ walk from Barcelona’s Passeig de Gràcia Boulevard.

There are several restaurants within a 5-minute walk from Guitard Grand Passage. Also, the hotel is only 500 metres from Hospital Clinic Metro Station.

There are good transport connections to Barcelona El Prat Airport from Passeig de Gràcia Metro Station, located around 15 minutes’ walk away.

Attractively situated in the centre of Barcelona, Hotel Casa Gardenia features air-conditioned rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, free WiFi and a terrace. This 2-star hotel offers luggage storage space. The property is non-smoking and is situated 2.8 km from Sant Sebastian Beach.

The rooms in the hotel are equipped with a flat-screen TV. The private bathroom is fitted with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer.

Buffet and continental breakfast options are available each morning at Hotel Casa Gardenia.

Speaking English, Spanish, French and Italian, staff are ready to help around the clock at the reception.

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Plaça Catalunya, Portal de l'Angel and Passeig de Gracia Metro Station. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 12 km from the property.

Pestana Arena Barcelona is less than 5 minutes’ walk from Barcelona’s Plaza Espanya and Fira Exhibition Centre. It offers a gym, sauna and modern, air-conditioned rooms with free wired internet access.

Some rooms offers free use of the Maritimo Meeting Room, up to 12 people, for private meetings.

Pestana Arena Barcelona is just 3 minutes’ walk from Las Arenas Shopping Centre and you can walk to Sants Station in 8 minutes. You can get to the Rambla in 5 minutes from Plaza Espanya Metro.

Rooms feature parquet floors and stylish décor. Each one has work desk, a pillow menu and an LCD TV with satellite channels.

The hotel’s restaurant serves Mediterranean food and has a terrace. There is also a bar where you can get a snack or a drink. The hotel's breakfast includes products for celiacs.

Until further notice, the use of jacuzzi is prohibited due to the existing drought in Catalonia.

Situated 300 metres from L’Illa Diagonal Shopping Centre, the Derby is a 20-minute walk from FC Barcelona’s Camp Nou stadium. Each air-conditioned room offers flat-screen satellite TV and free internet access.

The stylish Derby Hotel has an impressive collection of Catalan art, including pieces by Miró and Tàpies. Rooms have functional design and parquet flooring. They all include a safe and a minibar.

Hotel Derby features Italian pizzeria Santa Napoli and cocktail bar with Peruvian nuances Lima Bruja.

Located just 10 metres away, the Gran Derby Hotel allows guests access to its gym and swimming pool. Hospital Clinic Metro Station is 800 metres away, while the Feria Trade Fair in Plaza Espanya can be reached in a 20-minute walk.

Located in Barcelona, 500 metres from Passeig de Gracia and 1.3 km from the centre, Aspasios City Oasis Apartments provides air-conditioned accommodation with free WiFi, and an outdoor swimming pool. The property has pool and garden views, and is less than 1 km from Casa Batllo. The apartment features family rooms.

Each unit comes with a sofa, a seating area, a flat-screen TV, a well-fitted kitchen with a dining area, a safety deposit box and a private bathroom with a hair dryer. A dishwasher, an oven and microwave are also provided, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. At the apartment complex, all units are fitted with bed linen and towels.

Guests can also relax in the garden.

Popular points of interest near the apartment include La Pedrera, Plaça Catalunya and Passeig de Gracia Metro Station. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 13 km away.

Set within the World Trade Center building, this 5-star design hotel overlooks Barcelona’s port and is a 5-minute walk from La Rambla. It features a seasonal rooftop pool, a gym and a spacious terrace.

The Eurostars Grand Marina Hotel GL offers modern rooms with wooden flooring and warm-coloured fabrics. A flat-screen TV with satellite channels and a spacious work desk are featured in each room. A pillow menu is also available.

The chic Grand Marina restaurant serves Mediterranean meals prepared with seasonal ingredients, while the lobby bar features exotic cocktails and live music. In the mornings, a rich breakfast is served on the terrace, weather permitting.

The Marina GL's gym offers cardiovascular equipment and free weights. Massage services are available.

Drassanes Metro Station, providing links to the rest of the city, is just 500 metres from the hotel while Barcelona Airport is 15 km away.

Hotel España is situated in a 19th-century building in central Barcelona, within 100 metres of the Ramblas and Liceu Theatre and 200 metres from Boqueria Market. Its Mediterranean restaurant is run by famous chef Martín Berasategui. There is free high-speed WiFi available throughout.

The stylish and elegant rooms include a flat-screen TV and air conditioning. They also come with a modern bathroom.

Hotel España offers a variety of drinks and cocktails at AlAire rooftop terrace bar. There is also a small swimming pool.

Liceu Metro Station is 100 metres away and the Gothic Quarter is less than 5 minutes’ walk away.

Hotel Regina Barcelona is set in a historic 19th-century building, just 50 metres from Barcelona’s Plaza Catalunya and the Ramblas. The hotel offers free high-speed WiFi and modern rooms.

The century-old hotel was founded in 1917 and features beautiful architecture, including its impressive art nouveau entrance.

The Hotel Regina Barcelona’s spacious rooms come with air conditioning, central heating and satellite TV. There is free tea and coffee, a safe, work desk and minibar. The private bathroom includes ecological cosmetics and a hairdryer. Some rooms have a balcony.

A varied buffet breakfast with zero-kilometre and homemade products is served. There is also a bar and room service is offered all day from 07:00 to 00:00.

The Regina has a 24-hour front desk and a tour desk. Gaudí’s Casa Batlló and La Pedrera, on Passeig de Gràcia Avenue, are within a 10-minute walk away. Catalunya Metro and Train Station and the airport bus stop are within 5 minutes' walk.

Molino Fresh is a self-catering accommodation located in the heart of Barcelona. Cafeterias and tapas bars are 70 metres away. La Rambla, Barceloneta and its port are 1 km away.

The air-conditioned apartment includes a seating area with sofa and flat-screen TV and heating. The kitchen is equipped with a stove, oven and microwave. There are 2 bathrooms with a  shower.

Plaça Catalunya is 2 km away. Molino Fresh is 15 km from Barcelona El Prat Airport.

This hotel is located next to Avinguda Diagonal and Passeig de Gràcia, ideal for shopping. Guests can easily access Plaza Cataluña and the city’s historic gothic quarter. Free Wi-Fi is available.

Situated along the modernist route, Hotel Catalonia Gracia is surrounded by much of the interesting architecture that Barcelona is famous for, such as Gaudí and Domenech i Muntaner's key buildings, including La Pedrera.

A buffet breakfast is available at the on-site restaurant; room service is also available.

Guests can easily enjoy this cosmopolitan city as Hotel Catalonia Gracia is within walking distance of Barcelona’s many attractions. As well as the excellent public transport links providing swift access to the entire city and the surrounding area, the hotel offers great value for money. The hotel also includes meeting amenities and conference rooms available for business events and banquets.

Centrally located in Barcelona, Hostal Amra is a modern guest house only 100 metres from Plaza Catalunya and Las Ramblas. It offers free WiFi throughout.

The Amra features a Minimalist design and has a tour desk with ticket service. There is a terrace and coffee is available for guests. Bike and car rental  and luggage storage are offered.

All rooms have air conditioning and come with high-end mattresses, a TV and a private bathroom with hairdryer. Some rooms have a balcony with views of the garden and the city.

Passeig de Grácia is 5 minutes’ walk away and plenty of places of cultural interest like Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are within a short walk away. Parking is possible nearby for a surcharge.

Situated in the charming residential district of Sarrià, this elegant design hotel offers an outdoor pool and garden area, overlooking Tibidabo Mountain. Free Wi-Fi is available.

The Ikonik Anglí’s spacious rooms have a minimalist design and large windows, which provide plenty of natural light. Each air-conditioned room includes a flat-screen TV and a modern bathroom with a range of amenities.

Guests can enjoy a daily breakfast in the Angli’s stylish breakfast room. The Sarrià district is known for its wonderful cake shops, and there are also many popular bars within a 5-minute walk. The hotel also offers meeting rooms for events.

Sarrià FGC Train Station is 600 metres from the Ikonik Anglí, and offers direct services to Barcelona city centre. Plaza Catalunya Square is just a 10-minute train ride away. The nearest airport is Barcelona Airport, 15 minutes drive away from the hotel.

Aspasios Catedral Apartments is centrally located, 2 minutes' walk from Barcelona Cathedral and 4 minutes from Plaza Catalunya. It offers free Wi-Fi and a small rooftop pool with a sun terrace and views of the cathedral.

The spacious, modern apartments feature wooden floors and have a living room with a sofa and Smart TV, with which you can use the internet and Skype. The well-equipped kitchenette includes a washing machine and dishwasher.
Set on the corner of Portal de l'Àngel, a popular shopping street, Catedral Bas Apartments's location means that many museums, shops and restaurants can be reached by foot. Las Ramblas and Passeig de Gràcia are a 5-minute walk away.

You can walk to the port in 10 minutes and the beach in 15 minutes. There is also a children's playground opposite.

Airport buses stop at nearby Plaça de Catalunya, where there are several Metro, railway and bus connections.

Featuring free WiFi, Ola Living Hostal Diagonal is located in Barcelona. Set 800 metres from Passeig de Gracia, famous for its luxury shops, this hotel offers modern rooms with air conditioning.

Each heated room at this hotel has modern décor and includes 1 double or 2 single beds, a flat-screen TV and wardrobe. The private bathroom comes with a shower and hairdryer. Some rooms have a spa bath. All are on the ground floor.

The hotel offers a lounge area.

You can find several restaurants, bars, and grocery shops within a 5-minute walk of Ola Living Hostal Diagonal Exclusive rooms. Diagonal Metro Station is 850 metres from the property, and Plaza Catalunya is 2 stops away.

Our reception is located at 228 Aribau Street. The opening hours are from 09:00 to 20:00, Monday to Sunday.

Check in time is 3:00 PM. If you arrive earlier we can store your luggage at reception until your apartment is ready. Also after your check out (11.00 AM).  You can leave your luggage at the reception.

The apartment has opening through a smartphone. If you need a face-to-face check-in later than 9:00 PM.  There is a surcharge of €30.

Hotel Moderno has a central location, on a side street just 20 metres from Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas. It offers free Wi-Fi access throughout.

All rooms at the Moderno are heated, air conditioned and soundproofed. There is also cable TV, a fridge and a private bathroom with toiletries.

The hotel is just a short walk from the Boquería Market on La Rambla. Plaza de Catalunya and the city’s cathedral are just a few minutes’ walk away.

The hotel’s City Tour offer is ideal for exploring the city. There is also a ticket service. The 3 computers in the lobby can be used for free.

The Moderno has a 24-hour front desk and offers express check-in and check-out.

Set in a 19th-century building beside the enchanting Palau de la Música building, these chic and spacious apartments offer fashionable accommodation in the city’s historic heart.

Spend your Barcelona city break in style with a stay at Palau de la Musica Apartments. The interior of each apartment comes with tiled and parquet floors to complement the stylish design.

Prepare your own meals in the apartment’s well-equipped kitchen. Other great amenities feature music equipment, satellite TV and air conditioning for the warmer months.

As soon as you walk out of your apartment you will find yourself in the fashionable, central district of El Born – full of chic bars, restaurants and boutiques. The Gothic Quarter and La Rambla are also just a short walk away.

Some of these stylish apartments have  Mediterranean Sea views and free WiFi.

Decorated in light colours, the bright air-conditioned You Stylish Beach apartments feature private bathrooms, fully equipped kitchens and dining areas with a balcony. A flat-screen TV and a DVD player can be found in the living room.

Some apartments have access to a shared outdoor swimming pool and terrace.

Avinguda Diagonal Avenue and Selva de Mar Metro Station are both less than 600 metres from the apartments. Barcelona’s historic Gothic Quarter is just 6 metro stops away.

hotel_name: Central and Basic Universitat for YOUNG HOSTEL
description:
Set in the lively Ciutat Vella District, next to the MACBA Museum, it is 5 minutes’ walk from Plaça Universitat Square.

Decorated with bright colours, all the rooms come with single beds which can be joined together and some have a private bathroom with shower. Free toiletries are also provided.

Central & Basic Universitat is surrounded by a wide range of shops and supermarkets. You can find some of the trendiest restaurants and bars of the city in a 5-minute walk.

The Ramblas and Boquería Market are 800 metres away and you can walk to Plaça Catalunya Square in about 10 minutes’ walk. El Prat Barcelona Airport is 30 minutes by public transport. Regular buses leave from a bus stop located just 800 metres away.

Hostal Girona is located in the historic heart of Barcelona, a 10-minute walk from Passeig de Gràcia and Plaça Catalunya. It offers free Wi-Fi.

Hostal Girona is a small and modern guest house with a lift. All rooms are air conditioned and have a TV. Some rooms are en suite and others have a shared bathroom.

Gaudí’s Casa Batlló and La Pedrera are within walking distance. Private parking is possible nearby, at a daily cost.

The guest house occupies a historic, 19th-century building. The building was part of the Quadrat d’Or. This block was designed by the father of the Eixample neighbourhood, Ildefons Cerdà.

Located in Barcelona’s chic Eixample district, just 600 metres from Gaudi's La Pedrera, LeMar by Aspasios offers comfortable rooms with free Wi-Fi, 5 minutes’ walk from Passeig de Gracia Boulevard.

LeMar by Aspasios bright rooms feature stylish, modern décor. Each has a 22-inch plasma TV and a safe, while bathrooms feature hairdryer, shower and free toiletries.

The property is 300 metres from Diagonal Avenue and Gaudí’s La Pedrera and Casa Batlló are around 600 metres away. Tourist information and a ticket reservation service are offered at Forget Me Not.

Provença FGC train Station is 150 metres away and buses around the city pass 30 metres away. You can catch a direct bus to Barcelona El Prat Airport from Plaza Catalunya Square, 10 minutes’ walk away.

Set just off Barcelona’s famous Las Ramblas, 3 minutes’ walk from central Plaza Catalunya, Catalonia Ramblas 4* Sup  features a seasonal outdoor pool with a south-facing terrace, a poolside snack bar and a chill-out area.

Housed in a modernist building, all bright and spacious rooms come with a flat-screen satellite smart TV equipped with Chromecast App, free WiFi and tea and coffee facilities. Some have a private terrace with a private pool. Room service is available.

The spa at Catalonia Ramblas 4* Sup features a relaxation area. It includes a sauna, a steam bath and a hot tub. Massage and beauty treatments are also available.

The hotel’s restaurant, Pelai Restaurant, offers Catalan market cuisine. Dishes cooked on a coal stove are available at the Pelai terrace, a rooftop terrace with a chill-out area with panoramic city views. A buffet breakfast is offered every morning and, on weekends, it is available until 11:00.

In the summer months, the terrace is open until 00:00 and has a summer menu, as well as cocktails and milkshakes.

Located in Barcelona's Plaza de España, Hotel Catalonia Barcelona Plaza offers a seasonal rooftop pool and a terrace with panoramic city views. It also has a fitness room, beauty salon and free Wi-Fi.

The property is located next to Espanya Metro Station. In the square there are numerous bus stops that connect with other parts of the city, with the Fira Barcelona fairground and with Barcelona airport.

All spacious rooms are equipped with air conditioning, satellite TV, a safe and a private marble bathroom with hairdryer. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout, and Smart TVs with Chromecast apps are available. Choose one of the two clock suites and you will have incredible views of Montjuïc from the floor-to-ceiling windows. If you prefer, the hotel also has rooms and suites with private terrace.

The Catalonia Barcelona Plaza serves a daily buffet breakfast in the Simultáneo space, Barcelona's new meeting point that fuses cultural and leisure activities with the best gastronomic offer. Come to Simultáneo to telework with free wifi, to have an informal meeting, to enjoy a concert or to have an afterwork cocktail.

Do you already know the  Simultáneo Gastrobar? An avant-garde space that offers unique haute cuisine dishes. If you book half board, you can enjoy the Gastrobar menu during lunch or dinner.

The Filigrana restaurant specialises in modern Catalan cuisine made with local ingredients. You can also visit the Japanese restaurant Kurai or have a drink on The Clock terrace, overlooking Montjuïc.

The Catalonia Barcelona Plaza has a spacious business centre with 3 large conference rooms and 8 meeting rooms, all equipped with the latest technology.

This is our guests' favourite part of Barcelona, according to independent reviews.

Located within less than 1 km of Sants Railway Station and a 15-minute walk of Magic Fountain of Montjuic, Sweett - Carrer Fira provides rooms with air conditioning and a private bathroom in Barcelona. There is a private entrance at the apartment for the convenience of those who stay. The apartment features family rooms.

All units comprise a seating area with a sofa, a dining area, and a fully equipped kitchen with various cooking facilities, including a dishwasher, an oven, a microwave and a toaster. With a private bathroom equipped with a hair dryer, units at the apartment complex also provide guests with free WiFi, while selected rooms include a balcony. At the apartment complex, all units are fitted with bed linen and towels.

Casa Batllo is 2.2 km from the apartment, while Plaça Catalunya is 2.6 km away. Barcelona El Prat Airport is 11 km from the property.

Featuring air conditioning, Habitat Apartments Cool Jazz is set in Barcelona, 1.1 km from Sagrada Familia. Park Güell is 2.1 km away.

The accommodation is fitted with a flat-screen TV. There is also a kitchenette, fitted with an oven and microwave. A toaster and refrigerator are also offered, as well as a coffee machine and a kettle. There is a private bathroom with a shower and a hair dryer in each unit. Towels are featured.

La Pedrera is 2.2 km from Habitat Apartments Cool Jazz, while Plaça Catalunya is 2.8 km from the property. The nearest airport is El Prat Airport, 15 km from the property.

Featuring free WiFi, Amra Barcelona Gran Via is located in Barcelona, within a 10-minute walk of Plaza Catalunya and Arc de Triomf. This guest house offers a shared terrace and garden.

Each air conditioned room at this guest house has a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, free safe, and work desk, plus a minibar and coffee machine. The private bathroom includes a bath or shower, hairdryer, and free toiletries.

The property also offers a ticket service and  parking for an extra charge. Guests can make use of our chill-out sun terrace.

You can find several restaurants, bars, and grocery shops within a 5-minute walk from Amra Barcelona Gran Vía. Plaza Catalunya is 750 metres from the property, and Gaudi's Sagrada Familia is just 2 metro stops away.

hotel_name: La Casa de Antonio Boutique Rooms
description:
Featuring free WiFi, La Casa de Antonio Boutique Rooms is located in Barcelona. This guest house is set a 7-minute walk from Plaza Catalunya and 94 metres from Universitat Metro Station.

This guest house has a Modernist décor and offers air-conditioned rooms in the centre of Barcelona. Each room comes with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels and tiled floors, and the private bathroom includes a bath or shower, hairdryer, and free toiletries.

There is a tour desk available to all guests, and the property can arrange a shuttle to the airport for an extra charge.

You can find several restaurants, bars, and a grocery shop within a 5-minute walk of La Casa de Antonio Boutique Rooms. Plaza Espanya and the famous Montjuic Fountain are 2 metro stops from the property, and Gaudi’s Sagrada Familia is 2.7 km away.
